faq.q: What is a titanium subsea manifold swivel flange?
faq.a: A titanium subsea manifold swivel flange is a precision-machined oil & gas component used in subsea manifold piping swivel flange. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V ELI for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium subsea manifold swivel flange?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium subsea manifold swivel flange manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange is manufactured using Ring forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium subsea manifold swivel flange?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
